India Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Oil Facilities

India has condemned attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi militant group on Saudi Arabian oil facilities and civilian infrastructure. The strikes, which occurred on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, have raised concerns about further escalation in the West Asia conflict. India stated that such attacks undermine regional security. The attacks reportedly injured 73 people.
